_comment: NEVER REMOVE these entries. Confirmed by the food bank itself; applied by scripts/build.py on every nightly refresh and they override automatic classification.

b30-south-birmingham.label_en: Warehouse – donations only. Clients cannot visit here. See distribution centres below.

b30-south-birmingham.evidence: Confirmed by B30 & South Birmingham Foodbank (Jeanette), Oct 2026: Unit 17 Kings Norton Business Park B30 3HZ is their warehouse; clients must not turn up.

droitwich-spa.evidence: Droitwich Spa Foodbank site lists 'Foodbank Office – St Andrews Parish Centre'. Food is collected at Droitwich Spa Baptist Church WR9 8QS. https://droitwichspa.foodbank.org.uk/locations/ Approved by Dean, 21 Oct 2026.

aberdeen-south.label_en: Admin office – delivery only. Call 07360 162919 to arrange.
aberdeen-south.label_cy: Swyddfa weinyddol – danfon yn unig. Ffoniwch 07360 162919 i drefnu.
aberdeen-south.evidence: Aberdeen South Foodbank site: 'TLC 18 Palmerston Road (Office Only)'; 'provide a home delivery service on Mondays and Fridays, but do not offer a drop in or collection service'. https://aberdeensouth.foodbank.org.uk/locations/ Approved by Dean, 21 Oct 2026.

southend.evidence: Southend Foodbank locations page: Friendship House, 484 Southchurch Road, SS1 2QA is the office and warehouse, open for donations only Monday, Tuesday and Thursday 9am-2pm. You cannot get a voucher or collect food there. The page says there are 4 distribution centres (Hawkwell SS4 1UP, Belle Vue SS1 2QZ, St Saviour's SS0 8LL, Shoeburyness SS3 9JD). The voucher page lists those 4 plus the warehouse. Checked 26 Oct 2026. https://southend.foodbank.org.uk/about-us/locations

kings-langley.evidence: All Saints community page: a foodbank every Tuesday 10am to 11.30am, and anyone in need of food is welcome to come and take what they need. Donations can also be left daily. This is a client session, not a donations-only office. Checked 26 Oct 2026. https://beneficeoflangelei.org.uk/allsaints/community/

galashiels-and-area.evidence: St Peter's Church, Parsonage Road, TD1 3HS is a place to collect food, including the Wednesday emergency walk-in. Checked 26 Oct 2026. https://galashielsfoodbank.wordpress.com/get-food/

helensburgh-lomond.evidence: Helensburgh Community Hub, 116 East Princes Street, holds client sessions Monday 10-12 and Thursday 3-7pm. St Modan's is a second session, not a reason to hide the hub. Checked 26 Oct 2026. https://helensburghlomondfoodbank.org/

york.evidence: York Foodbank own page: 'Unit 5 Sterling Park ... YO30 4WU (Depot address for donation drop off only. Open every Tuesday/Thursday 9-1pm or by arrangement)'. https://york.foodbank.org.uk/contact-us/ checked 27 Oct 2026.

glasgow-sw.evidence: Glasgow SW Foodbank own page: 'Please note, this is an office and warehouse premises only. No food parcels can be collected from this location.' https://glasgowsw.foodbank.org.uk/locations/ checked 27 Oct 2026.
